info.title: Emisell Portal API — local draft/review milestone
info.description: Separate admin/developer control-plane principals. No public registration, publishing, runtime activation or merchant management. Developer organization comes exclusively from authenticated membership. Lists return the latest 200. Approved review is NOT a signed or published release. HTTP/loopback development only; not an internet deployment security profile. ADR 0022: authoring/distribusi baru hanya shipping/v1. Payment gateway checkout internal Emisell, bukan aplikasi umum. Record payment historis tetap terbaca; reject/suspend/revoke tersedia. Pengajuan/approval/sign/publish dan kesiapan app-client/Testing payment ditolak. Instalasi/RPC payment fixture tidak diubah.

post.description: Unified dashboard login. Body contains only email/password; identity and surface resolved by backend. Ambiguous matching credentials rejected. Sets HttpOnly host-only emisell_portal_session at /api/v1; HTTPS uses Secure. Exact dashboard origin required. Legacy API permissions remain unchanged.

200.description: Authenticated user with server-selected surface and role

401.description: Invalid or ambiguous credentials

403.description: Wrong origin

get.description: Read unified cookie session. Requires exact dashboard Origin/Referer; returns user with backend-selected surface. Does not accept client role or organization overrides.

401.description: Missing or expired session

403.description: Wrong origin

get.description: Administrator-only read directory of admin portal accounts. Requires admin session and exact Admin Origin/Referer. Returns at most 50 accounts ordered by ID; pass nextAfterId as afterId. Enabled is login eligibility, not online presence. No passwords, sessions, invitations, role changes or developer accounts are exposed.

401.description: Missing or expired session

403.description: Wrong origin or not administrator

get.description: Administrator-only read directory. Requires admin session cookie and exact Admin Origin/Referer. Returns at most 50 organizations ordered by ID; use nextAfterId as afterId. No account emails, credentials, or membership writes.

401.description: Missing or expired admin session

403.description: Wrong origin or not administrator

get.description: Administrator-only organization detail. Requires admin session cookie and exact Admin Origin/Referer. Read-only; no email or credentials returned.

401.description: Missing or expired admin session

403.description: Wrong origin or not administrator
